name: Latent interposer (learned format converter)
plain: Small residual convnets trained per pair of VAE formats, for moving a latent from one family to another without a decode and encode. Conversion is by weights only. Downloads weights from Hugging Face at run time when not local. The node offers v1, xl, v3, fx, ca as source and v1, xl, v3 as destination.
math:
y=head(x) (conv path + short path, ReLU), upsample by scale (0.5 for ca), 12 ResBlocks, BatchNorm, SiLU, tail conv
ch_mid=64; channels by pair (4↔4, 4↔16, 16→16)

claims.text: Fetches weights from HF when absent, a network side effect at run time
